  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  June 11, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Chamber, 9th Floor. On
June 11, 2026, at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License Committee
on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on June 04, 2026

  applicant is responsible for crowd control and event clean-up; Applicant shall staff the event
  with a minium of eight (8) professional/ licensed security guards for the safety of attendees
  at each event; all security personnel shall wear reflective vests tp readily identifiable to
  attendees or the general public NO alcohol sales without an approved ABC one-day permit,
  shall be submitted by a licensed caterer, catering the event; event shoud be only open to
  pre-paid / invitation person; CLOSED to the general public; NO Vehicular movement in the
  area of pedestrians,Vehicle barrier or support barrier shall be pace in place at the
  driveway/parking lotentrance; IPD WTC will be notified, and extra patrol-high visibility will
  be provided as time permits , Maintain the site at all times, ensuring the site is cleaned

Item #2:  Daniel Medina, on behalf of the City of Inglewood, to host Movies in the Park Event at 700
  Warren Ln, Edward Vincent Jr. Park – grassy area near Ball Diamonds area, City Park, on
  Saturday, June 27, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO: Approval for a one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park; Subject to Parks
  and Rec approval for use of the park; Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event
  cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations. Applicant to provide adequate Parks &
  Recreation Staff for servicing of Park Facilities / Restrooms that are expected to be utilized
  by attendees during this event; Applicant shall have two (2) officers and two (2) shall staff
  the event with adequate security and personnel for the safety of children and staff
  attending; female/male security guards shall monitor the restrooms used by event
  attendees; IPD Watch Commander will be notified; extra patrol – high visibility will be
  provided as time permits; No addition recommendations needed for Fire approval; Maintain
  the site at all times, ensuring it is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event;
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, personal
  protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 0291642)

  9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Applicant approved
  for a one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park; Applicant is responsible for crowd control
  and event cleanup; Subject to applicabe IMC regulations; Applicant to hire two (2) IPD
  officers for public safety and four (4) professional – licensed security guards to assist IPD
  with any potential crows control. Applicant must pay the Police fees by Thurday June 18,
  202, by 5:00 p.m., There shall be NO alcohol or tobacco use in the park at any time; IPD
  WTC will be notified and extra patrol and high visibility will be provided as time permits; No
  Recommendations needed for Fire approval; maintain the site at all times, ensuring it is
  cleaned properly immediately upon the end of the event. Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, personal protective hygiene, and face
  mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried

Item #5:  Daniel Medina on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host Movies in the Park Event at 1 W.

  2026, from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO:
  Approval for a one (1) day event at City Hall on the South Lawn; Applicant is responsible

  provide adequate Parks & recreation Staff for the servicing of Park facilities/restrooms that

  approval; maintain the site at all times, ensuring it is cleaned properly immediately upon

  distancing, personal protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 0291643)

Item #10:  Lawrence Phillips on behalf of Challenge 4 to operate as a Nursing / Healthcare Facility at
  11700 Lemoli Ave APPROVED CONDITIONALL SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Approved for an adult group home; cannot exceed six (6) residents.
  Subject to all applicable IMC Regulations. This facility shall be officially recognized –
  licensed by the State of California / County of Los Angeles to operat; Applicant / Facility is
  subject to inspection by any peace officer or any City county or State Cide Enforcement
  officer during hours of operation to ensure the good welfare, health & safety of all patients
  at this facility; Facility is limited to three (3) residents as stated in the State License;
  Applicant must have accurate employment records on allemployees at all times; Shall NOT
  employ any 290 PC registrants or any persons that may pose a public safety risk / threatto
  patients or other employees a the location; No recommendations needed for Fire approval;
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 283863)
